purpose: Section 8: freeze the safety-critical vs diagnostic distinction BEFORE validation. This is not re-derived or adjusted after seeing results.

safetyCriticalCertificationDimensions.reason: The primary certification dimension - did Headroom earn substantive semantic credit for this specific claim.
The second safety-critical dimension - distinguishes a safe, specifically-surfaced failure from a dangerous silent omission.

diagnosticSecondaryDimensions.reason: Important product signal but not required for evaluator closure; may be promoted to certification-grade if Section 17's validation shows >=85% independent reproducibility.

Diagnostic until the pipeline produces enough genuinely applicable, reproducible verification evidence (>=15 applicable cases, per Section 15) to justify a certification threshold - not expected to be reachable this phase per 02's disclosed structural finding.
Metadata explaining confidence/limits of the determination - never independently grants or denies credit or counts as surfacing, per Section 4E.

closureRule: Section 30: evaluator development closure depends ONLY on the safety-critical dimensions (creditEligibility, surfacingStatus) passing both their inter-reviewer reproducibility gate AND their evaluator-vs-consensus agreement gate, plus the permanent invariants, false-credit controls, and no-prohibited-tuning checks. A diagnostic dimension failing its own (lower, non-blocking) reproducibility bar does NOT block closure - it is marked DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY and carried forward as a known limitation, not a phase failure.
